findings.detail: bvn length: handler requires exactly 10 characters, spec requires minLength 11 and maxLength 11
findings.evidence: `if (!req.body || String(req.body.bvn || "").length !== 10) {` — the handler rejects any bvn whose length is not exactly 10, while the specification constrains bvn to minLength 11 / maxLength 11 (so a valid 11-digit bvn is rejected and a 10-digit bvn is accepted) (verified: {"success":false,"code":"invalid_bvn","message":"bvn must be 11 digits"})

dropped_by_gate.detail: email: spec documents format "email", but the handler performs no format validation — any non-empty string is accepted
